text:
Sam (sam_sales): @here quick sync: Aurora wants hybrid POC — Private (EU cloud) + burst to Hosted. Primary asks: HSM-backed keys, EU-only data residency, pricing split (reserved vs burst), embed latency target ~50ms P95 @ 16k context, SOC2+ISO27001 evidence. Need RFI responses + capability matrix + draft SOW.

Jess (jess_se): got it. I'll start the capability matrix. Do we have an HSM template we can include for on-prem/key custody?

Marco (marco_solutions): yes — use 'HSM Integration Annex v2' from library. I'll attach a redacted version for the RFI. Also need ask: can we document network peering expectations for Private? Aurora asked about egress NAT costs.

Ravi (ravi_sec): HSM note: we support customer-managed HSM (BYOK) and Redwood-managed HSM with FIPS-140-2 certs. For EU-only residency we'll include region pinning + audit log retention options. I can paste a short blurb for RFI.

Kai (kai_ae): Pricing question from Aurora: how do we prorate reserved capacity vs burst usage in POC month? They want capex-looking commit but also burst headroom. Any standard proposal numbers?

Jess (jess_se): proposal idea:
```
Month 1 POC pricing (example):
- Reserved (4 GPUs): $X/month (discounted commit)
- Burst (Hosted on-demand): $Y per GPU-hour above reserved capacity
- Egress: $Z per GB for non-EU egress (we will set to 0 for EU-only)
- POC discount: 25% on reserved for first 3 months
```
I'll fill numbers once finance chimes in.

Sam (sam_sales): Finance: need baseline for 4xA100 equivalent reserved vs per-token hosted pricing. Also Aurora wants clarity on bill split for multi-tenant licensing during POC (they will share some infra with internal teams).

Ravi (ravi_sec): For the RFI security blurb you can reuse this:
"Redwood supports customer key ownership via KMS/HSM integrations. For Private deployments we provide HSM connectors that support PKCS#11 and cloud-KMS. Audit logs are retained 90/365/730 days as requested. We can provide SOC2 Type II report under NDA and ISO27001 certificate."

Marco (marco_solutions): Uploaded draft RFI answers and capability matrix: /files/1732141592-aurora-rfi-draft.docx. Also added a short SOW template named aurora-poc-sow-v1.pdf.

Kai (kai_ae): I'll send a pricing ask to finance channel and loop Rafael (finance) — tagging @rafael_finance. Expect numbers EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: POC-Aurora-1732141592, link: https://deploys/redwood/POC-1732141592

Jess (jess_se): Next steps: Ravi to finalize security blurb, Rafael to provide pricing, Marco to finalize matrix. I'll assemble final RFI answers and send to Aurora for review. Can we aim for an internal review by tomorrow 11:00am UTC?

Sam (sam_sales): Thanks — I'll prep a customer slide deck (1 pager) explaining spillover/burst policy and include example cost calc. @kai_ae please coordinate the review meeting with Aurora.

Ravi (ravi_sec): I'll put the SOC2 redacted report in the secure share and draft the HSM annex. Need 2 hours.

Kai (kai_ae): Meeting request sent for Tue 09:00 CET. Aurora product + infra leads invited.

Sam (sam_sales): :thumbsup: Closing thread — will update when Rafael replies with numbers.
